case.summary: Case CASE-005 (Card SC-03005-K949): The real-time risk model scored transaction 4012170 at 0.85, triggering review [EV-7076ad79]. The card SC-03005-K949 showed one prior transaction averaging $253.18 and two online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-eb69790a, EV-abd160eb]. The transaction originated from a device marked 'New' for this account (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0) and used an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-73a7ecec, EV-fecfcf6e]. The customer has one prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4320) and the same device profile appears in another confirmed fraud case [EV-1ccddb63, EV-82502e0b]. Six prior closed cases share the 'card_not_present_new_device' pattern [EV-db6d4f0e]. The customer denied making the purchases and confirmed physical card possession [EV-bcc81b4c].

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report documents confirmed card-not-present fraud on card SC-03005-K949 (customer SC-03005) involving transactions 4012170 ($430.53) and 4012171 (total exposure $683.71). The real-time risk model assigned a score of 0.85 to transaction 4012170, prompting investigation [EV-7076ad79]. The fraudulent transactions were initiated from a previously unseen device fingerprint (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0) and routed through an anonymous proxy IP located in Argentina, both strong indicators of account takeover [EV-73a7ecec, EV-fecfcf6e]. The device profile has been linked to at least one other confirmed fraud case, and the customer has a prior fraud history (CC-4320) [EV-1ccddb63, EV-82502e0b]. The customer explicitly denied authorizing the purchases and affirmed physical possession of the card, supporting true-name fraud classification [EV-bcc81b4c]. Six historical cases exhibit the same card-not-present new-device pattern, confirming a recurring modus operandi [EV-db6d4f0e]. Total financial exposure is $683.71. The case is closed with a fraud verdict and referred for loss recovery and card reissuance.
